title: Scientists discover miracle pill
text: A viral post claims a secret pill can make people live forever without any medical testing or evidence.

title: Celebrity announces impossible cure
text: An online article claims a famous actor discovered a universal cure that doctors have supposedly hidden from the public.

title: Government gives every citizen unlimited money
text: A fabricated story says every citizen will receive unlimited money starting tomorrow without any official announcement.

title: Moon turns green tonight
text: A fictional report claims the moon will permanently turn green tonight because of a mysterious cosmic event.

title: Drinking one glass reverses all diseases
text: A misleading article says one glass of an unnamed drink instantly reverses every known disease.

title: Secret device reads every thought
text: A fabricated report claims a consumer device can read anyone's thoughts perfectly from across a room.

title: Schools closed forever
text: A fake report claims all schools have been permanently closed nationwide without an official government notice.

title: Engine runs without fuel
text: A viral article claims a car engine can run forever with no fuel or energy input.

title: Hidden city found under ocean
text: A fabricated report claims researchers discovered a giant modern city under the ocean and kept it secret.

title: Instant language learning chip
text: A false story claims a new chip can make anyone fluent in every language within five minutes.

title: Miracle crop grows overnight
text: A fictional article says a new seed can grow a mature crop overnight with no water or sunlight.

title: Phone battery lasts 100 years
text: A viral claim says a new phone battery lasts 100 years and never needs charging.
